title: EOS — rerun 10-worker Agent Master stress test after cost fix
intent:
Rerun the intentional 10-worker Claude Agent Master stress test through EOS after #832 corrected cost/capacity semantics, so the experiment measures actual provider capacity behavior instead of stopping on modeled dollar cost.

Required work:
Launch exactly 10 parallel read-only workers with these scopes:
1. Inventory / transfer integrity
2. Truck inventory / allocation / reservation
3. Receiving readiness and remaining activation risks
4. Work-order idempotency / replay / race conditions
5. Dispatcher / assignment / parts-readiness
6. Firestore Rules / authorization tail sweep
7. Functions privileged-callable / deployment-boundary review
8. Sales / fulfillment latent integrity risks
9. Equipment / technician / field-mode correctness
10. Cross-system P0/P1 sweep for anything prior audits missed

Use one Agent Master consolidator only. Workers must cite authoritative repository evidence and classify findings as NEW, DUP, ELEVATED, CLEAN, or UNRESOLVED. No recursive worker spawning. No more than 10 workers total. Do not retry a worker unless execution itself fails; maximum one retry for execution failure. Maximum one correction pass per worker result. If a worker still fails, record the failure and continue; do not create an endless verifier/correction loop.

Cost/capacity requirements after #832:
- Do not enforce modeled/estimated Claude execution cost as billed spend.
- No implicit economic-cost cap is authorized for this experiment.
- `actualProviderCostUsd` must be authoritative billed cost or `UNKNOWN`.
- `estimatedExecutionCostUsd` may be recorded but must not stop the run.
- Stop only for a real provider-capacity limit, explicit Owner reserve, concurrency limit, authoritative API budget limit, or another governed fail-closed condition.
- Record `budgetStopReason`, capacity telemetry, freshness, and provenance accurately.

Capture, where exposed: per-worker tokens, tool calls, duration, total wall-clock, failures/retries, duplicate rate, new findings, findings per worker, overlap/coordination cost, consolidation burden, actual vs estimated cost, and Claude short-window/weekly/concurrency capacity effects.

Final consolidation must include: top 10 actionable findings; NEW/DUP/ELEVATED breakdown; recommended execution order; dependency graph; genuine Owner decisions only; security/integrity risks; 10-worker telemetry table; direct comparison to #831 and the prior 5-worker run; whether 10 workers improved useful coverage; whether coordination/dedup overhead became excessive; recommended practical Agent Master worker ceiling; and task categories that should be routed to Cortex in a future mixed-provider run.

Completion:
Complete only when all 10 worker outcomes (or bounded execution failures caused by real governed capacity limits) have been consolidated, the existing Verifier has reviewed the result, and a durable EOS result is published. Explicitly report whether all 10 workers actually launched and completed, why any did not, and confirm no repository/product mutation occurred. Do not implement findings or automatically start another run.
scope: Execution: EOS → Claude Agent Master → exactly 10 parallel read-only workers → one consolidator → existing Verifier → durable EOS result.
Read-only only. No product/source mutation, patch application, merge, deployment, permission/grant change, backlog mutation, or production action.

Use #831 as the budget-limited baseline. Dedup against durable findings from #802, #818, #819, EOS-STRESS-RUN-001, and #831. Re-report known findings only when new evidence materially changes priority, scope, or confidence.
